ob.title: Set up WhimprFlow
ob.intro: Grant these to WhimprFlow, in order. Each turns green here the moment macOS applies it. No relaunch needed.
ob.accDetail: Detects the Fn key in every app and types your words. This is the one that makes the Fn key work everywhere.
ob.micDetail: Lets WhimprFlow hear what you say.
ob.inputDetail: Extra reliability for key detection. Optional. You can enter without it.
ob.hint: If a permission stays grey after you flip it on in System Settings, toggle WhimprFlow off and back on in that pane. The state here will update within a second.

in.heatHint: Each square is a day. Keep the streak alive by dictating something every day.

tr.sub: Drop a voice memo, recording, or any audio file. WhimprFlow transcribes it with your configured engine.

tr.dictNote: Your dictionary spellings are applied automatically.
hp.title: Help
hp.sub: A few tips to get the most out of WhimprFlow.
hp.b1: Press and hold your dictation key (Fn by default), speak naturally, then release. WhimprFlow transcribes on-device. Nothing leaves your Mac unless you choose a cloud cleanup engine.
hp.t2: Cleanup happens where your cursor is
hp.b2: Release the key and your cleaned-up text is typed straight into whatever app has focus: email, chat, notes, code. Choose how aggressive the cleanup is under Settings → Auto Cleanup.
hp.b3: Open Dictionary and add names, jargon, or acronyms it keeps mishearing. Add the correct spelling plus any "also heard as" variants and WhimprFlow will fix them automatically.
hp.b4: Hold Alt+Space with text selected and speak an instruction ('make this formal') to rewrite it in place. Hold Alt+W anywhere, ask a question, and the answer is typed at your cursor. Start a dictation with 'auf Englisch:' to translate as you speak.
hp.b5: Under Settings → Cleanup Engine, run fully offline (Local), paste exactly what you said (Raw), or add an OpenAI / Anthropic key for cloud cleanup. Keys are stored in your macOS keychain.
set.title: Settings
set.langSub: Hub and pill language. System follows macOS.
set.pillSub: Where the pill lives. You can also just drag it there. The lowest pair sits at the very bottom of the screen, beside the Dock.
set.hotkeySub: Fn always works: hold to talk, tap to toggle. Add a second key here if you like.
set.hkModalSub: F-keys work alone. Letters and numbers need Ctrl, Alt or Cmd. Esc cancels.
set.hkUnsupported: That key can't be used. Try another one.
set.hkNeedsMod: Add Ctrl, Alt or Cmd to that key.
set.trSub: Where your speech is turned into text.
set.trCloudHint: OpenAI-compatible audio API (Mistral Voxtral, Groq Whisper, OpenAI). Uses the OpenAI API key below. Falls back to local if the request fails.
set.engineSub: Where your dictation is cleaned up before it's typed.
set.openaiHint: Cloud cleanup via OpenAI (or an OpenAI-compatible API like OpenRouter, set the base URL below)
set.keyReplacePh: Enter a new key to replace
set.baseUrlHint: Base URL (blank = OpenAI; e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 for OpenRouter)
set.lvlNoneHint: Transcribe exactly what you said, including mistakes.
set.lvlLightHint: Clean up filler words and grammar. (Recommended)
set.modelMissing: Needed for your current settings, but not installed.
set.localServerHint: Self-hosted server? Point the base URL at it (mlx-lm: http://localhost:8080/v1, Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1) and leave the key empty.
set.asrDetail: Whisper large-v3-turbo, runs on your Mac. Required for offline dictation.
set.llmDetail: Qwen 3 4B for on-device text cleanup. Optional if cleanup runs in the cloud.
set.typingSub: Words per minute when you type. Used for the "time saved" stat.
set.soundTitle: Play a sound when recording starts
set.ctxSub: Reads the text around your cursor so cleanup understands names and what you're replying to. Stays on this Mac.
set.permsSub: Grant these to WhimprFlow, then quit and reopen the app.
set.permAccDetail: detects the Fn key + types text
